elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Your Android has a spam call filter. It's probably switched off.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on Filter spam calls.

[friendly] In the Phone app, tap the dots, then Settings. Open Caller ID and spam. Switch on Filter spam calls.

[delighted] Spam stops ringing, and it still waits in your call history.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
